timeline_disposition.reason: Modern scholarship securely places Kumārila Bhaṭṭa in the later seventh century, with a representative floruit around 660 CE, but dependable person-specific geographic and political biography is not securely established. Traditional accounts of study, travel and debate are hagiographic and are not used to fabricate a single polity-bound Activity rail.

sources.title: Kumārila — Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.citation_text: SEP states that Kumārila Bhaṭṭa flourished around 660 CE and warns that his biography is known largely through stylized traditional hagiographies.
